hunks.baseline: “Half a shichen? What does that mean?”
hunks.sol: “Half a shichen? What do you mean?”

hunks.baseline: “Didn’t you say you’d done it until you were sick of it? That should be enough time for you.”
hunks.sol: “Didn’t you say you’d done it until you were sick of it? That should be plenty of time for you.”

hunks.baseline: “That’s true, but... Ah, I get it. Do we have to make nonstop round trips for half a shichen?”
hunks.sol: “Well, yes, but… Oh, I get it. I have to run back and forth without stopping for half a shichen?”

hunks.baseline: “No. For now, you only have to do it once. I’ll wait for you at the summit.”
hunks.sol: “No. Once will be enough for now. I’ll wait for you at the summit.”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. There.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. Up there.”

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin and I both dropped our jaws.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin’s and my jaws dropped at the same time.

hunks.baseline: The height was impossibly vast. Even judging by eye, it was a steep cliff hundreds of jang high. My vision went dark, and my hands and feet began to tremble.
hunks.sol: The cliff towered impossibly high. Even at a glance, it was hundreds of jang tall and nearly sheer. My vision darkened, and my hands and feet began to tremble.

hunks.baseline: If I was like this, Hyuk Mujin was obviously even worse.
hunks.sol: If it affected me this badly, Hyuk Mujin had to be even worse.

hunks.baseline: “Are you saying we’re supposed to climb that?”
hunks.sol: “Are you saying… we have to climb that?”

hunks.baseline: “Yes! I chose it because it’s about the same height as the place I climbed every day when I was little.”
hunks.sol: “Yes! I picked it because it’s about the same height as the place I climbed every day when I was little.”

hunks.baseline: “Oh, it brings back memories. I fell halfway down and nearly died twice. It really hurt back then.”
hunks.sol: “Ah, that brings back memories. I fell halfway down and nearly died twice. It really hurt.”
